name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure BM.GPU.H100.8 / BM.GPU.H200.8
region: OCI commercial regions (Oracle does not itemise the regions on the price-list page)
price_basis: per GPU per hour - Oracle's price list quotes GPU shapes PER GPU PER HOUR, not per instance: BM.GPU.H100.8 = $10.00 and BM.GPU.H200.8 = $10.00. Shape suffix .8 means 8 GPUs in the bare-metal shape. Published 2026-10-03.
notes: THE HEADLINE FINDING TO CHECK, AND IT NO LONGER HOLDS. OCI's bare-metal H100 80GB has been the cheapest credible hyperscaler H100 hour in this repo's memory - comfortably under AWS p5's on-demand $6.88-equivalent per-GPU figure once you divide correctly - but as of 2026-10-03 Oracle's own price list puts BM.GPU.H100.8 at $10.00 per GPU-hour, which is MORE than AWS p5 on-demand ($6.88) and roughly level with Google a3 ($11.06) and Azure ND H100 v5 ($12.29). The historical 'OCI is dramatically cheaper for GPU' claim is no longer true for Hopper on list price, and that is worth recording explicitly rather than letting a stale belief propagate. What Oracle still has going for it: the bare-metal shape has no hypervisor overhead and no vCPU/NRAM bundling to pay for, unlike every hyperscaler record here - so this $10.00 buys eight H100s and a host, whereas $6.88 on AWS buys one H100 plus 24 vCPU and 256GB of RAM you did not ask for. That bundling is the real reason the hyperscaler per-GPU numbers look worse than a neocloud's, and OCI is the only record in this slice quoted per-GPU on a whole host. Availability is genuinely UNKNOWN here: OCI has a well-earned reputation for out-of-capacity errors on GPU shapes, and the price list says nothing about capacity - this is the one record in the slice where I could not verify availability from the vendor's own page, so do not plan around it. Currency caveat: the price list renders in the reader's selected currency and was read with USD selected; Block Volume and Object Storage are both $0.0255/GB/month, cheap relative to the Big 3. A credit card and an OCI account are enough; there is no sales call.
